title: Output Mapping Commutes with a Run
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine, let $f$ be a partial symbol map, let $w$ be a finite word of choice bits, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$. Running the machine with its transition outputs mapped by $f$, starting from the configuration whose output is mapped by $f$, gives the same result as first running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ and then mapping the resulting output by $f$.
